status: CANDIDATE DECISION RECORD — awaiting Ryan selection (one recommended + one alternative)
note: No experimental model call made. Facts from DeepSeek primary API docs (api-docs.deepseek.com, 2026-08).
provider_reproducibility_note: DeepSeek API does NOT expose a seed parameter. Determinism relies on a frozen low temperature plus recording the per-response system_fingerprint for audit. This matches Protocol §6 provenance provision.

recommended.rationale: Frontier model already available via the environment DEEPSEEK_API_KEY at api.deepseek.com/v1/. Non-thinking mode keeps output to the atomic single-decimal response contract (no chain-of-thought). Near-zero temperature maximizes reproducibility given no seed support. 16 max output comfortably fits one decimal.

alternative.rationale: Same provider/format; stronger capability may yield a more discriminative applicability signal, but higher cost and latency with no guarantee of a better Stage 0 gate.

tradeoff: flash (recommended default): cheapest, fastest, matches the env default small-model role; adequate for a raw 0.00-1.00 applicability probe. pro (alternative): stronger, costlier, slower; could improve signal but Stage 0 only needs AUC>=0.60 with one-sided lower bound>0.50, so capability beyond flash is likely unnecessary for this narrow probe.
audit_provenance: when scoring runs, record per-response: model, system_fingerprint, usage, timestamp, to satisfy Protocol §6 if exact reproducibility is not guaranteed.
